test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

The story ______ me to make up fancy names for myself.
solution: The correct answer is **"inspired."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Inspired"** means to be motivated or influenced to do something creative or imaginative. (विशेष मनोभाव, वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति द्वारा प्रेरित) • **Example**: *The pianist gave an **inspired**__ performance.* • In this context, the story inspired the person to come up with fancy names for themselves. • The use of **"to" **after **"inspired"** indicates that the person was inspired to do something specific, in this case, make up fancy names. • The sentence is grammatically correct and makes sense with the use of **"inspired."** • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *The story __**inspired**__ me to make up fancy names for myself.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"declared"**, means to state something publicly and officially or to make something known in a firm, clear way. ((कोई बात) सार्वजनिक और आधिकारिक रूप से घोषित करना, (किसी बात की) घोषणा करना) • Option 2, **"activated"**, means to make something start working. (सक्रिय करना, क्रियाशील बना देना) • Option 3, **"told"**, is a possibility, but it does not convey the same level of motivation as "inspired" does. It means to give information to somebody by speaking or writing. (कुछ बताना, जानकारी देना (बोलकर या लिखकर)) 35:Ta3c, The correct answer is** "make a mistake".**
